title: Critical graphs are connected
statement: Let $G$ be a graph on a finite, nonempty vertex set, and suppose $G$ is critical: every proper subgraph $H \subset G$ satisfies $\chi(H) < \chi(G)$. Then $G$ is connected.
hypotheses_covered: G is critical: every proper subgraph has strictly smaller chromatic number
replaced:
\emph{An easy consequence of the definition is
that every critical graph is connected.}
